entry.name: barHidden
entry.label: Written by the plasmafusion-tablet KWin script: whether the top bar of this widget's screen is hidden now (the settings page's "Hide the top bar automatically"). The island shows while it is.

entry.name: noticeRequest
entry.label: From the tablet KWin script: Plasma's pop-up came up on this screen and was made transparent; the island shows Plasma's notice (a new value each time).

entry.name: islandRequest
entry.label: Testing only: "open:NONCE" opens the island, "close:NONCE" closes it, as a click and Esc do.
